subject: Post-demo follow-up: target unit rates & host comparisons
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@signalhealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@signalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: target unit rates & host comparisons

Hi Marta / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — great to see the product flows and the clinical use case. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we stay aligned: 

- Volumes: you indicated 8–12M tokens/month for the initial pilot (50k–80k requests/month, avg 150 tokens per request).
- Budget signal: internally you mentioned a target FY27 run-rate budget in the $12k–$15k/month range allocated to inference.
- Unit target: you highlighted wanting a goal unit price in the $8–$12 per 1M tokens range to make the unit economics work versus downstream revenue.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) You to confirm a 3-month pilot window and provide the MVP prompt/results set (you mentioned the shared Google sheet).
2) We (Redwood) to return a concise pricing benchmark showing expected $/1M token for the pilot given the volume band, plus side-by-side comparisons vs OpenAI / Anthropic / two popular open-host providers.
3) If pricing aligns, we’ll prepare a short pilot SOW and a dedicated onboarding slot.

I’ve attached our one-pager benchmark template and a stub pricing cheatsheet — those will help make the comparison transparent (what’s included: token accounting, prefix caching assumptions, KV cache hit expectations, and any model quantization we’d recommend).

Quick clarifying question for you: when you say $8–$12/1M tokens, is that expected to be total delivered cost (including any vendor host fees) or a target for Redwood-managed inference only? We want to make sure we’re comparing apples-to-apples vs the hosted vendors they’re evaluating.

If fine, we’ll aim to get the benchmark back by Tuesday EOD.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_pricing_cheatsheet.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@signalhealth.com>

Date: 2026-10-11T17:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: target unit rates & host comparisons

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the summary and the template — that looks useful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Volume confirmation: pilot scope should be 10M tokens/month (we can scale after month 1).
- Budget: the $12k–$15k/month is the total inference budget we have carved out; that needs to cover model hosting + any vendor fees.
- Unit price interpretation: the $8–$12/1M target is for total delivered cost (i.e., what we pay end-to-end). So if we pay a hosted model fee + Redwoods inference cost, that combined needs to fit in that range.

For benchmarking, please include the following comparators and assumptions so our procurement team can validate:
- OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini or closest publicly available spec) — per-1M token list price we’ve seen around $20–$25, but add network/overhead for realistic delivered cost.
- Anthropic (Claude X equivalent) — include both streaming and non-streaming cost differentials.
- Two open-model hosts: include an example of a spot/discounted reserved commit host at scale (e.g., host A) and a fully-managed expensive host (host B) so we can see the tails.

We’ll upload the MVP prompt sets to the shared Drive by tomorrow morning. Please include any caching/seq-length assumptions you use in the calculation (we need to sanity-check).

Thanks,
Marta
Director of Product | SignalHealth
marta.ruiz@signalhealth.com

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding Marta’s reply (below). Key takeaways for pricing build:

- Pilot set to 10M tokens/month; budget cap is $12k–$15k/month total delivered.
- External comparator prices to include: OpenAI (~$20–$25/1M listed), Anthropic (higher for larger-context models), plus two open-host examples (one with reserved commit discounts, one higher fully-managed).
- Marta explicitly asked that our returned $/1M number be the delivered cost for SignalHealth (host fees + Redwood).

Preliminary math (rough) for internal review:
- If target delivered is $12k for 10M tokens => target = $1.2/1M tokens — that can’t be right given market pricing. I think Marta meant $12k–$15k/month for their *total* inference + product infra, but they expect Redwood to be a low-cost component. Reconfirming.

Ask: Marissa, can you draft two pricing scenarios for me to send back:
1) Minimal: Redwood-managed inference only, with conservative caching (20% prefix hit) and a single open LLM replica (quantized where safe) — show $/1M and total pilot month cost.
2) Delivered: Combined line item that includes host fees (we’ll model OpenAI and a sample open-host reserved commit) + Redwood runtime — show final $/1M delivered and highlight where we can compress costs (batching, KV cache, model variant).

Karthik — flag any quantization/throughput caveats (latency SLO adjustments) and recommended model variants for the cost bands. Also let's include the Drive link with the prompt set once Marta uploads it.

Target: send the benchmark back to the customer by Tuesday EOD (2026-10-13).

Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
